business_summary: Nippon Chemical Industrial Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells various chemical products in Japan, Asia, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company provides inorganic chemical products, including chromium compounds, phosphorus compounds, silicates and silica products, and other inorganic chemicals, such as lithium chloride solution N, sodium sulfate, sodium bisulfate, potassium permanganate, and cuprous oxides. It also offers specialty chemicals, such as electronic ceramic materials, barium compounds, circuit materials, battery materials, organic phosphorus compounds, pharmaceutical intermediates and agrochemicals, pigments and paints, semiconductor materials, as well as other specialty products comprising thiourea; and custom manufacturing. In addition, the company manufactures and sells phosphine derivatives, agricultural chemicals, battery materials, electronic ceramic materials, circuit materials, and high-purity electronic materials. Additionally, it engages in leasing land and buildings to hospitals and retail businesses. Further, the company exports its products to Southeast Asia and other countries. The company was formerly known as Nippon Seiren Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nippon Chemical Industrial Co., Ltd. in March 1944. Nippon Chemical Industrial Co., Ltd. was founded in 1893 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
